games.name: [RELEASE] Fatal Combat
games.desc:
Fatal Combat is a new experience developed by Martial Arts Inc. Learn comboes, face down the strongest, unlock hidden characters, race to the top of the Ranked and most importantly have fun!

🎮💻📱 You can play on any device of your choice.
⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more future updates.

🖥️  Controls

- Left Mouse Button • punch
- G • ultimate mode
- F • block
- Q • dash
- Q (while ragdolled) • ragdoll cancel/evasive
- Q + M1 • Rushdown
- 4 M1s facing wall • Wall Combo
- B • Emote Wheel

Note that this game is still in development. Expect bugs and glitches, and if you find any, consider reporting them to the developers of the game.
